title: Low-valency scalable quantum error correction with a dynamic compass code
summary: The ongoing development of hardware that is capable of reliably executing general quantum algorithms requires quantum error-correcting codes that are both practical for realisation and rapidly reduce logical error rates as they are scaled up. Here we introduce the dynamic compass code, a code that can be implemented with a modest footprint on the heavy-hex lattice while also demonstrating a threshold.
